description: Paulo na Barnaba bavuga ubutumwa muri Antiyokiya bwankwa n’Abayuda bwemerwa n’abanyamahanga, buzura umunezero na Mpwemu Yera.
name: Abayuda banse agakiza, Paul agahindukiriza abanyamahanga.

description: Imana itwipfuriza kwamana nayo ibihe vyose, turi ku mugozi umwe.
name: Amarushwa Paulo yagize ariko avuga Ubutumwa bwiza.

description: Ingene ikinyoma ca Ananiya na Safira cahanywe, abaherezi bahana Intumwa kubera bamamaje ubutumwa bwiza.
name: Ananiya na Safira babesha Mpwemu Yera.

description: Izina rya Yesu ryashizwe hejuru kubwa Paulo muri Efeso. Abacuzi b’ikigirwamana ca alutene barwanije Paulo, yashishikaye gusangira n’abizera.
name: Benshi bizeye kubw’Ubutumwa bwa Paulo.

description: Paulo yireguye imbere ya Feliki kandi abwira ubutumwa Feliki n’umugore. Yarireguye n’imbere ya Festo.
name: Feliki ajana Paulo mw’ibohero, yiregura imbere ya Festo.

description: Paulo yireguye imbere ya Festo; Umwami Agripa na Belinike bagiye gusura Festo, nawe abiganira ivya Paulo. Paulo yashingiye intahe Agripa.
name: Festo yiganira abanyekombe ivya Paulo.

description: Abakristo bambere bari mu bumwe bituma Ishengero rikura.
name: Gukura kw’Ishengero.

description: Sauli amaze guhura na Yesu, yabaye intumwa yiwe mu mahanga. Ibitangaza vya Petero vyazanye benshi ku gakiza.
name: Ibikorwa Petero yakoze i Luda n’i Yopa.

description: Petero ashishikara kwigisha yemeza abayuda ngo bihane bizere Yesu Kristo.
name: Ibikorwa vya Petero na Yohana.

description: Abayuda bagiye inama yo kwica Paulo ariko kubw’umugambi w’Imana, bamujana kumunyegeza I Kayisariya mumpisho mu kumukiza.
name: Imana ihumuriza Paulo.

description: Inama yabereye I Yerusalemu yerekanye ko ivyagezwe vya Mose ntibishobora gushikana umuntu mu gakiza, arik’umuntu akizwa kubwo kwizera.
name: Inama yabereye I Yerusalemu ihuje intumwa.

description: Imana ntiheba abananiwe bari mu muhamagaro, ariko ibuzuza ububasha bwa Mpwemu Yera ngo bubakoreshe.
name: Ingene Herode yapfuye, n’urugendo rwambere rwa Paulo.

description: Intumwa zashimye Imana kubera ingingo zafatiwe I Yerusalemu, maze zikwiragiza Ubutumwa mu banyamahanga bamaze kwizera. Mu rugendo rwa kabiri rwa Paulo, atandukana na Baranaba.
name: Ingene ingingo zafatiwe I Yerusalemu yashitse mu mashengero yose.

description: Ishengero ritoranya aba diyakoni; Stefano yashingiye intahe Yesu maze bakamurementaniriza ibinyoma.
name: Ingene Ishengero ryatoranije abo kugaburira Abapfakazi.

description: Petero yajanye ubutumwa bwiza muri Antiyokiya maze Imana imugobotora mu maboko ya Herode.
name: Ingene Ubutumwa bwashitse i Antiyokiya.

description: Paulo aja I Roma, bagize ingorane y’umuyaga ukomeye kuko hari mu rushana. Ubwato bwasanzariye mu kiyaga ariko ntihapfa n’umwe muri 276.
name: Ingorane y’Umuyaga mu bwato, bagana I Roma.

description: Inkone yasomye Ivyanditswe vyera maze Mpwemu Yera atuma Firipo kuyisigurira ivyo isomye maze ica irizera Yesu Kristo.
name: Inkone y’Umunyetiyopiya yizera Yesu Kristo.

description: Paulo yagendeye amashengero yashinze mu rugendo rwiwe rwa mbere, Mpwemu Year amwankira kuja I Tilowa.
name: Intumwa Paulo yemera kurongorwa na Mpwemu Yera.

description: Yesu amaze kuzuka, yiyeretse abigishwa biwe ari muzima, amarana nabo iminsi mirongwine. Yarabihanikirije ngo barindirire isezerano i Yerusalemu.
name: Intumwa zisezeranirwa Mpwemu Yera.

description: Imana ikura Paulo na Sila mw’ibohero baca baja gukwiza Ubutumwa.
name: Ishengero ryaguka kandi hari ihamwa.

description: Abayuda batonganya Petero ko yinjiye mu nzu y’abanyamahanga, ariko bahava batahuye ko Imana yari yabagendeye.
name: Mpwemu Yera ashika ku bari mu nzu kwa Koruneliyo.

description: Paulo avug’Ubutumwa I Korinto; ubutumwa bw’ukuzuka kw’abapfuye bwazanye ibihari vyinshi ariko bamwe barizera.
name: Paulo amenyesha abany’Atenayi Imana akorera iy’ariyo.

description: Gusozera Igitabo c’Ivyakozwe n’Intumwa; twabonye ivy’Urugendo rw’Ivugabutumwa rwa Paulo, ingorane yagize zose n’ingene Imana yabanye nawe.
name: Paulo ashika I Roma.

description: Apolo, umunyabwenge, umunyabushobozi mu vyanditswe yigishirije I Korinto ivya Yesu avyitondeye.Muri Efeso, Paulo yabatije abigishwa ba Yohana mw’izina rya Yesu maze baca bakira Mpwemu Yera.
name: Paulo atangura urugendo rwiwe rwa gatatu.

description: Paulo I Tirowa yigishije ijoro ryose maze Eyutuko arakoroka kubera itiro agaca apfa. Paulo yaramusengeye arakira aca aja I Yerusalemu gutanga imfashanyo ku bapfakazi.
name: Paulo azura Eyutuko, aca aja I Merito.

description: Paulo yabandanije kwiregura imbere ya Agripa maze ajanwa I Roma kubw’umugambi w’Imana.
name: Paulo imbere ya Agripa, ajanwa I Roma.

description: Umuntu akizwa n’Ubuntu rw’Imana.
name: Paulo na Sila batererwa mw’Ibohero.

description: Paulo I Yerusalemu yiregura ko adakengera ivyagezwe. Bashatse kumwica kubera urwanko ariko abasoda b’abaroma baramukiza.
name: Paulo yiregura, aboheshwa iminyororo.

description: Paulo amenyesha ko ari umuroma bituma abacamanza bashiduka. Yarireguye imbere y’abanyekombe maze abafarisayo barwanira Paulo, bahanganye n’abasadukayo.
name: Paulo yiregura, yemeza ko ari umu Roma.

description: Ishengero rihamwa ariko Ubutumwa bushishikara gukwiragizwa. Simoni umunyamareba agomba kugura ingabire ngo ayicishe amahera.
name: Stefano aterwa amabuye.

description: Naho bari bamubangamiye, Stefano yise abamuhama “Bene se”. Yiregura abibutsa ingene Imana yabakuye muri Egiputa.
name: Stefano yemangira Kristo.

description: Ivyabaye ku ntumwa Mpwemu Yera abashitseko; Petero yigisha ari mu nkomezi.
name: Ubushobozi bwa Mpwemu Yera.

description: Ishengero rya mbere rimaze kuvuka, intumwa zakoreshejwe ibitangaza na Mpwemu Yera.
name: Ugushiramanga kwa Petero.

description: Imana yatumye Petero kuvugubutumwa mu nzu kwa Koruneliyo ; abari bahari bose bizera Kristo, bahabwa Mpwemu Yera.
name: Umumalayika w’Imana yiyereka Koruneliyo.

description: Abigishwa babujije Paulo kuja I Yerusalemu ariko aruhira kujayo asanga Abayuda b’intagondwa bamurega ko akengera ivyagezwe maze nawe ariregura.
name: Urugendo rwa Paulo agana I Yerusalemu.

description: Yesu amaze kuduga, Intumwa zarindiriye Isezerano zisenga zihuje imitima n’inama maze inkomezi za Mpwemu Yera zibasanga muri ubwo bumwe.
name: Yesu aduzwa mw'Ijuru..

description: Sauli abonekerwa n’umuco wa Yesu igihe yaja guhama abakristo b’i Damasiko.
name: Yesu yiyereka Sauli, arihana arabatizwa.
